title: VX Tales of the Drunken Paladin: Version IV! (2025)

posts.author: Drunken Paladin
posts.body:
​
Tales of the Drunken Paladin is a free-to-play JRPG that started its development journey in 2008. Its most recent release, Version IV, marks the fourth and final revision of a game seventeen years in the making.
You play as the unfathomably powerful, wealthy and washed-up hero of Maine, a man called "Anebriate," who whiles away his retirement getting hammered and generally being a public nuisance. That all changes when he wakes up one day with no money, no power, and no memory of ever having either. Join him on his quest to reclaim everything that was lost--and maybe even something he never had to begin with.
Tales of the Drunken Paladin was made by Steve Gibbon. The game is rated "M" for Mature due to its adult language and themes.
FEATURES:
An interactive world like no other. Virtually everything you encounter can be interacted with in a hilarious or profitable way!
A bizarre, original narrative adventure full of hilarious twists and turns.
Optional characters spice up dialogue and provoke decisions which may alter the results of your game.
Optional hidden bosses are a tough challenge but give rare, often one-of-a-kind treasures.
Look at the world differently depending on the time of day. Dozens of time-specific events are happening all around you!
Tons of side-quests and mini-adventures distract the protagonist from his goal, and give fun prizes or even money!
Hundreds of unique weapons and armor are found throughout the game, making character customization thought-provoking and interesting.
An exciting side-view battle system complete with "ATB" and unique character skills, as well as a range of hilarious items with which to sustain yourself in brutal combat.
The save points are magical hobos!
​

Just to clarify, the game can be played by anyone, regardless of whether they own any RPG Maker programs, but it cannot be edited in any RPG Maker program since it's encrypted.

posts.author: Drunken Paladin
posts.body:
HEY! COUPLA' THINGS:
Tales of the Drunken Paladin has received some pretty extensive rewrites/edits lately. Basically, when I started this game (I want to say '08? Whenever RPG Maker VX came out plus a month or so), I was just winging it. That's what we all have to do when we pick something up for the first time and start going to town--just winging it, emulating what we like, trying to learn the tools of the trade. And that's great! But revision is critical, and I'm finally getting around to making some much-needed revisions (although this isn't the first batch of revisions by any means).
So if you played it a long time ago and couldn't get into it, I definitely encourage you to try it again. Conversely, if you played it a long time ago and LOVED IT, it's a whole lot better now, so I'd wear a helmet when you fire it up just to be safe.
If you've NEVER played it, then I think it's just about damn time you do so.
Other Cool News:
- "Ohnovahkiin," the Tales of the Drunken Paladin Skyrim follower mod has gone live and is accessible both from the Steam Workshop and Nexus.
- I'll be working with Hootey again to do a full Tales of the Drunken Paladin web series (and live stream) very soon. I'll try to get around everywhere and post some notifications before it happens (it seems like this is the only RPG Maker forum that is still regularly attended?), but the best way to stay up to date on that stuff is to check out the
Facebook page
or my
web site
.
- We have this
REALLY thorough walkthrough
that contains like 99% of the content (even the secret, hidden stuff) in Tales of the Drunken Paladin. The other 1% is just because I like secrets too much to spoil them myself.

posts.author: Zeq
posts.body:
Spoiler:
Here's my take on the game
So here's my take on the game. This gem of game, Tales of the Drunken Paladin, is a satirical RPG Maker VX game that mixes traditional RPG mechanics with irreverent humor, over-the-top characters, and an absurdly entertaining story. The game centers around Anebriate, an amnesiac former hero-turned-drunken slob, as he embarks on a journey of redemption, self-discovery, and plenty of comical missteps. The narrative is a wild ride filled with witty dialogue, unexpected twists, and a healthy dose of self-awareness. Anebriate wakes up one day to find himself destitute, hungover, and surrounded by bizarre individuals.
As the story unfolds, the game takes jabs at traditional RPG tropes while delivering a surprisingly deep and emotional tale hidden beneath layers of comedy. The writing is one of the game’s strongest aspects. It's filled with clever one-liners, pop culture references, and absurd situations that keep players engaged and entertained. It follows a turn-based combat system typical of RPG Maker VX games. However, the gameplay is spiced up by creative skills, hilarious item descriptions, and well-balanced battles. The game does an excellent job of keeping combat fresh, with unique enemy designs and amusing mechanics. Leveling up feels rewarding, and the game provides a satisfying progression system. Despite its comedic nature, the game doesn’t shy away from challenging encounters that require strategic planning and resource management. It uses default assets blended with custom visuals and creative design choices to craft a unique world.
While it doesn’t boast cutting-edge graphics, the charm lies in its presentation and how well the environments and characters complement the humor and tone. The soundtrack is a mix of fitting melodies and comedic tunes that enhance the overall experience, well of course, some Final Fantasy. The audio cues, especially during comedic moments, add an extra layer of charm. It is a gem of an RPG Maker game that I truly enjoyed playing, that doesn’t take itself too seriously but delivers an unexpectedly deep and enjoyable experience. Its humor, creativity, and solid gameplay mechanics make it stand out among RPG Maker titles. While it may not appeal to players seeking a more traditional RPG, it’s a must-play for those who enjoy satire and offbeat adventures. Score 8/10
